published_implementation.historical_relation: preserved from the predecessor function-specific evidence record; no canonical organizational-function linkage is introduced by this migration

held_constant: serialized worktree creation in both primary arms
observations.disturbance: Parallel coding agents work against one shared codebase while nine tickets form three overlapping-footprint contention clusters. Without pre-start attenuation, second/third members can branch from stale shared state and collide at integration or silently poison composed behavior.
observations.treatment: Pre-start coordination gates dispatch of footprint-overlapping tickets until the prior overlapping ticket has integrated, so later work branches from the updated integrated state.
observations.reported_conflict_structure: All conflicts in the two primary uncoordinated runs occur on second or third members of the designed contention clusters. The coordinated arm integrates all nine contention-cluster tickets in both primary replicates.

excluded_variant.reason: same-batch dispatch-gate bug allowed overlapping tickets admitted in one batch to race; retained in raw data and excluded from the primary comparison

observations.causal_control_note: The same benchmark later reports that a git-only scheduler using the same pre-start check-in logic can match the coordinated Nool arm when declared footprints are accurate. This supports attribution to the coordination relation rather than to product branding alone.
observations.benchmark: Nool coding-agent fleet coordination benchmark — Track D scale-up 1
